comment: Canonical chunked-file decrypt vectors; see agent_docs/chunked-file-encryption.md §11. Generated by packages/e2e-crypto/scripts/generate-chunked-file-vectors.mjs (libsodium-wrappers). Plaintext byte i = (i*7+3) & 0xff; sha256 is of the plaintext. Keys and ciphertext are standard base64. Every case must decrypt (with `chunkSize` as the file metadata where given) and every rejected entry must fail, using `dek` unless the entry names its own. This copy in neutrino is the only editable one.
